items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That band hadn't gotten hold. I didn't know what to do next. I also got really restless about the rest of my life. ... politically, Reagan; me, I was at a real down part of my career.

ctx.x: San Francisco is great if you’re Denny Zeitlin.

Yeah, or you come from there. It’s not like this kind of temperament. No way. The people there are so slow. It’s just not going to happen. So I realized that. I knew, this is it. I’m on the East Coast for the duration. Although I entertained going to Europe, because as we get to ’88, one of the things – I had a bad period, and one of the things was to go to Europe. In any case, returning to New York was very – it was exciting. I was glad to be back. I was jamming. I was going out. I had a reputation. I was…
Did you ever talk to Eddie Henderson about this?
